meaning:
Χοραζείν (Rec. -ζίν), ἡ,
Chorazin, a town of Galilee: Mat.11:21, Luk.10:13.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago…
“Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long…
